page.overview:
Who is Donquino?

Donquino is the helmsman of the former Roger Pirates.

Donquino is a large man with thin limbs and short dark-colored hair and long sideburns. He wears a red modern captain's hat, a red and white striped sleeveless shirt, blue slacks, and dark shoes. He often has a pipe in his mouth. He also has an anchor tattooed on both arms.

Donquino is a jolly person, as he is often seen laughing and with a large smile. However, he was rather sad when Roger and Oden left the crew. Like any pirate, he loves treasure, and was very pleased when they managed to capture great wealth in the God Valley.

He is loyal to his crew and respects the captain, sharing joy with them during long voyages and mourning the loss of crew members. However, for his own sake, he may ignore the captain's orders or try to circumvent them whenever possible.
